name: shared-fact-store
body: The repo-wide delta/manifest store under `<git-common-dir>/apg/facts`, shared by every worktree and branch of the repository, against which the per-worktree local `db.lbug` is equated by content identity. A spec-only change-set that leaves the shared store's recorded key unchanged while a durable commit re-anchors the local `graph.jsonl` yields a state where the seed guard admits a seed whose authored rows are stale.
